## Why This Is Asked
Evaluates ability to design end-to-end testing for real-time ML systems with strict latency and availability.

- Real-time streaming tests
- Drift detection and calibration
- Rollback/fallback strategies
- Fault injection and synthetic data generation

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-test: check latency under load
describe('latency', ()=>{ it('meets 150ms target', async ()=>{ const t0=Date.now(); await faultDetection.run(testBatch); const dt=Date.now()-t0; if(dt>150) throw new Error('latency too high'); }});
```
